title: OpenWork: the open-source alternative to Claude Cowork
description:
OpenWork — the open-source alternative to Claude Cowork. it is a native desktop app that gives you that same "agentic" experience for free, running locally on your machine. Powered by the OpenCode engine, it wraps the chaos of a terminal agent into a clean, beautiful GUI. It features a proper permission system—so you know exactly when the AI is trying to delete a file—and a visual dashboard to track its plans and progress.

https://github.com/different-ai/openwork

#github #opensource
